title: CyberSoft Vietnamese Online Forum Toxic Speech & Moderation Benchmark
description: Multi-label text classification dataset covering Vietnamese community forum comments, annotated for toxicity, obscenity, identity attack, and insult. Used by AI Engineer students to train Transformer text classifiers (PhoBERT, ViBERT) and build safety guardrails for LLMs.

pii.handling_instructions: This dataset contains offensive vocabulary for academic content moderation research. Handles and identifiers have been pseudonymized.

transformation_pipeline: Scrape and deduplicate raw public forum threads
Mask all Vietnamese personal phone numbers, emails, and student ID tokens with [REDACTED]
Independent double annotation by 3 teaching assistants with Cohen Kappa agreement >= 0.85
Export stratified splits (Train/Val/Test) in Parquet format

core_competencies: Vietnamese Text Preprocessing & Word Segmentation (PyVi, Underthesea)
Model Interpretability & Attention Heatmaps (LIME, Integrated Gradients)
sample_business_questions: Can PhoBERT accurately detect subtle passive-aggressive toxicity in Vietnamese informal slang?
What is the Macro F1-score across under-represented minority attack categories?
What is the inference latency per comment when deployed on CPU with ONNX quantization?
recommended_exercises: Lab 09: Clean Vietnamese text and build a TF-IDF + Logistic Regression baseline.
Lab 10: Fine-tune PhoBERT using Hugging Face Trainer with early stopping.
Capstone: Build a real-time moderation filter microservice with FastAPI and ONNX.
